question: Should `ClawSegmentedControl` globally wrap every option set larger than four, or should wrapping be an explicit layout choice used by Skill Workshop?
rationale: Both approaches fix the demonstrated truncation, but repository evidence does not establish which behavior should become the design-system default for other callers and future screens.

options.title: Explicit wrapped mode
options.body: Keep the existing single-row default and let Skill Workshop request balanced wrapping through a narrow component parameter or caller-local wrapper.

options.title: Global count breakpoint
options.body: Accept the current implementation and define more than four options as the automatic wrapping rule throughout the Android app.

recommendation.title: Explicit wrapped mode
recommendation.body: Keep the existing single-row default and let Skill Workshop request balanced wrapping through a narrow component parameter or caller-local wrapper.
